text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking down the
hallway after
school, I overhear
Nakayama Festa and Agnes
Tachyon
talking. When I look into the room...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Trainer. Did the smell of
something
thrilling guide you here?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I lose, I have to test Tachyon's new
"deluxe
energy drink." The risk is big...
but so is the
reward.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I win, I get a first edition set of this
card game
created by a legendary
gambler. And, look, it's
unopened too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I obtained it through one of my
connections.
Now, don't believe I'm
recommending this
because cards are on
the line, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Agnes Tachyon pulls out a
deck of
playing cards.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Games are supposed to be fair. Playing
against
you in a regular card game would
put me at too
big of a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this instead. We will each build
a tower
with cards. Whoever builds the
higher tower is the
winner.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What? Well, I guess that's simple
enough...
What's the time limit?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Five minutes. Now let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without hesitation, Nakayama Festa
picks up a
card and starts building the
first layer, the
foundation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks stable enough to secure the win
for her,
but when I check to see how
Agnes Tachyon is
doing...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You're kidding.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aha. That's the second layer done.
Hmph, I must
be in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What're you talking about, Tachyon?
Are you
saying you've got this in your
pocket?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean. Whenever I
propose an
experiment to Cafe, she
challenges me to build
ten layers. So,
I've done this quite a few times.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But for some reason, my tower always
falls down
at the ninth layer. I've never
actually completed
one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: See? I've kept things fair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa clicks her tongue. But
seeing her
lips curl up, I can tell she's
enjoying herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Three minutes pass, and Agnes Tachyon
has
already started the fifth layer of her
tower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Only two minutes remain. The air is so
tense, I
can hardly breathe.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I finally finished the third layer... But at
this rate...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: There's a chill running down my spine, and my breathing's heavy. Now this is the kind of thrill I live for.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah-choo!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: T-Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. My nose got itchy... But there's
nothing to
worry about. I made sure to
look away.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hah! Perfect! I was just about to kick it
into high
gear.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(But what am I supposed to do to catch
up?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(I have to make a gamble and switch
things up.
It's the only choice I can
make!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wh-what in the heavens?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, Nakayama was putting five
pairs
per layer, but she suddenly
reduces it to two!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It just needs to be taller, right? There!
I'm on my
sixth layer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Reducing the base to pursue further
height...
You've sacrificed stability for
efficiency! Truly
amazing... You've bet
on a slim probability!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now for my seventh layer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Your eyes are bloodshot! And
you're
breathing rather heavily! Your
heart beat must be
racing! Here, let me
take your pulse!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a fit of excitement, Agnes Tachyon
carelessly
knocks down her tower of
cards.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That really took it out of me. It
was really
cathartic at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Unfortunate for me, but a
competition is
a competition. I admit my
defeat.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Accepted like a good sportsman. Right,
Trainer?
...Whoa. You're sweating as if
you staked your
own body on the bet.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Accepted like a good sportsman. Right,
Trainer?
...Whoa. You're sweating as if
you staked your
own body on the bet.
choice_data_list: L-Let me get you something to drink...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I know how you feel. I'm pretty thirsty
too...
choice_data_list: L-Let me get you something to drink...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, I only have these at the moment. If you want some, here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and I absentmindedly
accept the
bottled drinks and chug them
down in a few
gulps.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Wait a second!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We just drank Tachyon's Deluxe Energy
Drink.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm tired, though. I could almost
lie down
right here and take a nap.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How concerning, you two must be
exhausted.
Please, go ahead and lie
down where you are. I'll
nurse you back
to health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Nakayama Festa accepts the
limited-edition
cards, we politely
decline Agnes Tachyon's care
and
promptly exit the room.
